summary: Hesai Group filed a Form 6-K with exhibits containing a monthly return of equity issuer on movements in securities for April 2026 and an announcement regarding the record date for its 2026 Annual General Meeting. The monthly return shows no changes in authorized or issued share capital during the period. No special situation event is disclosed; the filing is a routine regulatory compliance report by a foreign private issuer listing on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange. There are no terms, prices, recommendations, advisors, or structural features typical of a special-situation transaction. The document merely confirms share capital static and meeting logistics. No deal terms or event-driven angle exists.
